name: Other seabirds
description: The rest of the seabird cast, above all the Cape cormorant (Phalacrocorax capensis) - itself Endangered and a specialist on anchovy - plus gulls, terns and other birds. Functional group pooling the source's Cape-cormorant and other-seabirds compartments; the source's other-seabirds group takes a quarter of its diet from outside the modelled web (discards and carrion), so this node's diet weights sum to 0.875.
